author: JAY JONES
hook:
Cleveland’s heroes are getting stronger.
So are their problems.
blurb: An Army tank has vanished. A bank vault is missing. And Daniel Orkleson has a shrinking ray, a wounded ego, and a shelf picked out for Terminal Tower.

Super Zerdo, Pink Blur, Fist-O-Mite, and Inspector Billy must stop Dork before Cleveland’s skyline becomes his trophy collection. But Lava Lips is spitting fire, Jaws is spoiling for a fight, and Fist discovers that an old enemy no longer remembers him.
With Flaming Head missing, the Defenders must rely on one another—and leave the door open for an unlikely ally.
